Same minimum = certified path; credit follows it; s(146) credited to #606

Lineage credit rule (Evan, 10-17): a later posting is a refinement when the two
are the same local minimum; otherwise the poster is the finder and the earlier
packing is "based on".  "Same" is decided by a certified continuous path from
the higher posting's core to the lower's with the side never above the higher's
(analysis/pathcert.py: per-pair separating line over each step with an explicit
curvature bound, shortfall closed by scaling, exact quadratic check at 50
digits; descent iterates via slp2.TRACE; rattlers excluded from the core).

- analysis/same_minimum.py: lineage pairs and every two postings within 1e-7 at
  one n; exact solves (descending postings that aren't at a KKT point); path
  certificates.  33 same (incl. 108 #432 -> #451), 34 distinct, 11 no path yet
  (261: a multi-pair corner switch), 7 unknown.  site/data/lineage_minima.json.
- provenance.py: one packing = within SAME_TOL and not decided distinct; the
  register's value goes to the posting carrying it when found_by's own claim is
  a different minimum (146 -> #606 based on #432; 179, 180, 209, 237, 238, 239,
  263 credit the improver based on #401); no synthetic register-N in `also`; no
  self "based on"; Compare history for every n <= 324.
- import_lists.py: raw-drawn records credit the earliest posting of the minimum
  (261: Ryan Xu, not the #567 repost).
- analysis/basin.py: distance / margin / growth prototype (growth push stalls
  in half the directions; superseded by pathcert for "same").

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Lean: path certificates are sound (PathCert.lean); step_ok checks 0 < s <= L

lean/Sqpack/PathCert.lean proves the step test of search/packer/analysis/pathcert.py
sound, no sorry, standard axioms only:
- chord_lower: f'' <= q on [0, 1] => f >= chord - t(1-t)q/2.
- hw_chord, pairGap_chord, wallGap_chord: the margins along a linear step, with the
  script's q = W dθo^2 + 2 D |dθo| + (√2/2) dφ^2 (pairs) and (√2/2) dθ^2 (walls); the
  half-width (|cos| + |sin|)/2 is handled as a max of four cosines, so no kink argument.
- disjoint_of_gapAt, subset_container_of_walls, disjoint_of_far (via ExactPack's
  SepSide / InBox); isPacking_scale: scaling by ρ >= 1 turns g + 1 - 1/ρ >= 0 (pairs)
  and m + (1 - 1/ρ)/2 >= 0 (walls) into a packing.
- StepCert (= step_ok's tests), step_isPacking, step_joined, chain_joined,
  joined_of_chain: a certified chain joins its end packings inside the packings of
  side <= L.  qmin_nonneg / cond_eq: the closed-form minimum covers [0, 1].
Outside the proof: 50-digit float evaluation (1e-30 margin) and the far-pair pre-filter.

pathcert.py: step_ok now rejects a step unless 0 < s <= L at both ends (the scaling
argument needs it; callers ensured it, step_ok didn't check).  108 #432 -> #451 re-run:
still certified (239 steps, worst margin 5e-13).
